seeded_by: agent-rule (catalog only — compute is agent-indicator's job)
notes: Catalog is the contract between agent-rule and agent-indicator. Do not change ids. Compute functions referenced in formula_pseudocode are stubs; agent-indicator implements them in services/regulatory-svc/indicators/compute/*.

indicators.name: balance_drop_30d_pct
indicators.description: Percentage drop in average current-account balance over the last 30 days versus the prior 30-day window.

indicators.name: min_balance_breach_count_30d
indicators.description: Number of days in the last 30d where end-of-day balance fell below the customer's declared minimum operating balance.

indicators.name: savings_to_loan_ratio
indicators.description: Ratio of total liquid savings to outstanding principal across all live loans.

indicators.name: income_volatility_90d_cv
indicators.description: Coefficient of variation of monthly inflows tagged as salary/business income over the last 90 days.

indicators.name: net_cashflow_30d
indicators.description: Inflows minus outflows over the last 30 days, normalised by EMI obligation.

indicators.name: salary_inflow_skipped_months
indicators.description: Consecutive months without an expected recurring salary credit.

indicators.name: loan_to_income_ratio
indicators.description: Outstanding principal divided by trailing 12-month declared/observed income.

indicators.name: overdraft_utilisation_pct
indicators.description: Used overdraft / sanctioned overdraft, averaged over 30 days.

indicators.name: repayment_delay_days_avg_90d
indicators.description: Mean days-late across repayments due in the last 90 days.

indicators.name: repayment_delay_streak
indicators.description: Consecutive late repayments (current run, ending today).

indicators.name: partial_repayment_ratio_90d
indicators.description: Fraction of repayments in the last 90 days where amount paid < amount due.

indicators.name: channel_login_drop_30d
indicators.description: Drop in mobile/web banking logins in the last 30d vs. prior 90d baseline.

indicators.name: support_complaint_count_60d
indicators.description: Number of contact-centre complaints filed in the last 60 days.

indicators.name: kyc_doc_expiry_days
indicators.description: Days until any mandatory KYC document expires (negative if already expired).

indicators.name: restructure_request_flag
indicators.description: Customer-initiated restructure or moratorium request raised in last 60 days.

indicators.name: unreachable_contact_count_30d
indicators.description: Failed-contact-attempt count by collections in the last 30 days.

indicators.name: outflow_to_inflow_ratio_30d
indicators.description: Total outflows / total inflows over the last 30 days.

indicators.name: large_outflow_anomaly
indicators.description: Latest 30d outflow exceeds 3 sigma above 90-day mean outflow.

indicators.name: cash_withdrawal_share_30d
indicators.description: Share of outflows that are cash withdrawals (proxy for opacity).

indicators.name: merchant_diversity_drop_60d
indicators.description: Drop in unique merchant count in last 30d vs. 30-60d-ago window.

indicators.name: bounced_payment_count_60d
indicators.description: Standing instructions / direct debits returned for insufficient funds in last 60d.

indicators.name: inflow_concentration_hhi
indicators.description: Herfindahl index of inflow sources over 90d (high = single-source dependency).

indicators.name: p2p_outflow_spike_30d
indicators.description: Spike in P2P/wallet outflows last 30d vs. trailing 90d baseline.

indicators.name: weekend_txn_share_change_60d
indicators.description: Change in share of transactions on weekends — proxy for income-mix change.

indicators.name: bureau_score_drop_60d
indicators.description: Absolute drop in CRB score within the last 60 days.

indicators.name: new_credit_inquiries_90d
indicators.description: Number of new bureau credit inquiries in the last 90 days.

indicators.name: external_dpd_max_90d
indicators.description: Max DPD reported by other lenders to the bureau in the last 90 days.

indicators.name: total_external_exposure_growth_90d
indicators.description: Growth rate of external (non-this-bank) outstanding balances over 90d.

indicators.name: ifrs9_stage_movement
indicators.description: IFRS 9 stage delta versus 90 days ago (1->2 = 1, 2->3 = 1, 1->3 = 2).

indicators.name: internal_dpd_current
indicators.description: Current days-past-due on the most-delinquent loan held with this bank.

indicators.name: collateral_coverage_ratio
indicators.description: Most-recent collateral valuation / outstanding principal.

indicators.name: guarantor_default_flag
indicators.description: Linked guarantor has defaulted on any obligation in last 180 days.
